definition: An exec is ground truth iff (a) the measurement workload launched it under a unique path and recorded its Popen pid and exit 0, AND (b) the independent ftrace reference instance recorded sched_process_exec for that path. Launched-but-not-in-ftrace execs are reported separately and excluded from the denominator.
workload: validation/strategic/measure/workload.py — K uniquely named copies of /bin/true, CONC concurrent
reference: validation/linux/ftrace_observer.sh — a private tracefs instance, read by a separate process from the pipeline

independence.SchedTracepoint_vs_ftrace: INTERFACE-INDEPENDENT ONLY: both read sched:sched_process_exec; ftrace uses the trace ring not perf, so a perf-only gate would separate them, but a hook on the tracepoint itself would blind both
independence.workload_record: the experimenter's control, written before any observer output was read; not an agent self-report
